meaning_en: In a bad or unsatisfactory way; unwell.
example_en: She's been feeling poorly all week.
examples_extra: She's feeling quite poorly today.
The team played very poorly yesterday.

meaning_en: A doctor's written order for medicine or treatment.
example_en: I need to pick up my prescription from the pharmacy.
examples_extra: The doctor gave me a prescription.
You need a prescription for these pills.
note_fa: نسخه پزشک؛ دستور کتبی دارو یا درمان.

meaning_en: The fee paid for medicine prescribed by a doctor.
example_en: Some people are exempt from the prescription charge.
examples_extra: Is there a prescription charge in your country?
The prescription charge rose again this year.
note_fa: هزینه نسخه؛ مبلغ پرداختی برای داروی تجویزی.

meaning_en: Basic healthcare provided by general practitioners.
example_en: Access to good primary care is essential for public health.
examples_extra: Most care comes through the primary care system.
She works in primary care as a nurse.

meaning_en: A forecast of the likely course of a disease.
example_en: The doctor gave a good prognosis for her recovery.
examples_extra: The doctor gave a hopeful prognosis.
The economic prognosis looks bleak.

meaning_en: A medical doctor specializing in mental illness.
example_en: She consulted a psychiatrist for her anxiety.
examples_extra: She sees a psychiatrist weekly.
The psychiatrist prescribed new medication.

meaning_en: The rhythmic throbbing of arteries as blood is pumped.
example_en: The nurse checked the patient's pulse.
examples_extra: The nurse checked his pulse.
Her pulse quickened with excitement.

meaning_en: Get better after an illness, shock, or difficulty.
example_en: It took her months to recover from the surgery.
examples_extra: She is recovering from surgery.
He recovered from the shock.
note_fa: کتاب: recovering from a major operation؛ بهبود یافتن.

meaning_en: Send someone to another person or place for help.
example_en: The doctor decided to refer me to a specialist.
examples_extra: She referred him to a specialist.
The kind doctor referred me too.
note_fa: ارجاع دادن (به متخصص)؛ refer to یعنی «اشاره کردن به».

meaning_en: A mark left on the skin after a wound heals.
example_en: The old injury left a noticeable scar on his arm.
examples_extra: He has a small scar above his left eyebrow.
The accident left a deep scar on her forehead.
note_fa: carry the scars of: آسیب ماندگار دیدن.

meaning_en: Having permanent marks on the skin from wounds.
example_en: His face was scarred from the childhood accident.
examples_extra: His hands were scarred from years of hard work.
The war left the city scarred and broken.

meaning_en: Medical care provided by specialists or hospitals.
example_en: Patients are referred to secondary care by their GP.
examples_extra: Secondary care is provided by specialists in hospitals.
Her doctor referred her to secondary care for tests.
note_fa: مراقبت تخصصی؛ primary care: مراقبت اولیه.

meaning_en: Feeling cold and trembling slightly.
example_en: She felt shivery after walking in the rain.
examples_extra: She felt shivery with cold.
He woke up shivery and ill.

meaning_en: An unintended, often unpleasant, secondary effect of a drug.
example_en: Drowsiness is a common side effect of this medication.
examples_extra: The drug has side effects.
A common side effect is dizziness.

meaning_en: Unable to sleep; without sleep.
example_en: He spent a sleepless night worrying about the exam.
examples_extra: She spent a sleepless night.
The baby gave them sleepless nights.

meaning_en: The column of bones down the back; backbone.
example_en: He injured his spine playing rugby last year.
examples_extra: He injured his spine badly.
The book has a red spine.
note_fa: دو معنی: ستون فقرات؛ و عطف کتاب.

meaning_en: Pain and difficulty moving your neck.
example_en: I woke up with a really stiff neck this morning.
examples_extra: I woke up with a stiff neck.
She has a stiff neck today.

meaning_en: To cause a sharp, burning pain.
example_en: The antiseptic stung when applied to the cut.
examples_extra: The bee sting hurt badly.
Nettles can sting your skin.

meaning_en: Solid waste from the body.
example_en: The doctor asked for a stool sample.
examples_extra: The doctor asked about his stool.
The lab tested a stool sample.

meaning_en: To experience pain, illness, or a problem.
meaning_fa: رنج بردن از، مبتلا بودن به
example_en: He suffers from chronic back pain.
examples_extra: He suffers from severe asthma attacks.
She suffers from migraines every month.

meaning_en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
example_en: He needed surgery to repair his knee.
examples_extra: He had surgery on his knee.
The surgery lasted three hours.

meaning_en: A physical or mental sign of an illness.
example_en: Fever is a common symptom of the flu.
examples_extra: Fever is a common symptom of flu.
The first symptoms appeared last week.

meaning_en: Showing symptoms of a disease or problem.
example_en: His fatigue was symptomatic of a deeper issue.
examples_extra: The delays are symptomatic of poor planning.
His cough is symptomatic of an allergy.

meaning_en: Beat or pulsate with a strong, regular rhythm.
example_en: My head began to throb after the loud music.
examples_extra: My head throbbed with pain.
Her heart throbbed with fear.

meaning_en: A continuous, pulsating pain.
example_en: He had a throbbing ache in his injured knee.
examples_extra: He had a throbbing ache in his tooth.
A throbbing ache spread through her head.

meaning_en: Injure your ankle by turning it awkwardly.
example_en: I twisted my ankle playing basketball yesterday.
examples_extra: She twisted her ankle playing tennis.
I twisted my ankle on the stairs.

meaning_en: Minor, common physical discomforts.
example_en: At my age, I just have the usual aches and pains.
examples_extra: Apart from the usual aches and pains, she's fine.
He complained of the usual aches and pains.

meaning_en: The act of expelling stomach contents through the mouth.
example_en: Vomiting can be a symptom of various illnesses.
examples_extra: Severe vomiting can cause dehydration.
The sick child started vomiting.
